senses.gloss:
(उ) चमु r. 1st and 5th cls. (चमति चम्नोति)
To eat, to drink, to take any thing into the mouth, as food, whether solid or liquid.
With आङ् prefixed,
(आचामति)
To sip as water.
With वि,
(विचमति)
To eat.

n. (-णं)
1 Astonishing, producing wonder or surprise.
2 Festival, spectacle.
4 High poetical composition.
E.
चमत् a sound of surprise, and करण making; also चमत्कार and चमत्कृति.

m. (-रः)
1 Astonishment, surprise.
2 Show, spectacle.
3 Row, riot, festive or angry turbulence.
4 Elaborate style or high poetical composition.
5 The name of a tree: see अपामार्ग.
E.
चमत् a sound of surprise, and कार making.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Uunsual, surprising, astonishing.
E.
चमत्कार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Surprised, astonished.
E.
चमत्, and कृत made.

f. (-तिः)
Display, spectacle, &c.: see चमत्करण.

n. (-रं)
1 A Chowri or long brush, most usually made of the tail-hairs of the Yak or Bos Grunniens, and employed to whisk off insects, flies, &c.
2 The name of a demon.
f. (-री)
A compound pedicle.
mf. (-रः-री)
A kind of deer, or rather the Bos Grunniens, erroneously classed by the Hindu writers amongst the deer.
E.
चम to eat or be eaten, अर aff.

nf. (-रं-रा or री-रं)
A Chowri, the tail of the Bos grunniens, [] used to whisk off flies, also as an emblem or insignia of princely rank.
E.
चमर the Yak or Bos grunniens, and अण् aff.

m. (-च्छः)
A small animal with a bushy tail; a squirrel.
n. (-च्छं)
A Chowri.
E.
चमर, and पुच्छ tail.

m. (-कः)
A species of ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.)
E.
चमर a Chowri, and ठक् affix, growing in clusters, resembling a Chowri.

mf. (-सः-सी)
1 A vessel used at sacrifices for drinking the juice of the acid asclepias, a kind of ladle or spoon.
2 A cake made of barley, rice, or lentils ground to meal.
3 A plant, commonly Khetpāpara, (Mollugo pentaphylla.)
4 A sweetmeat, or flour, sesamum, &c. mixed up with sugar into a kind of cake, &c.
E.
चम to eat, असच् Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

f. (-मूः)
1 An army.
2 A squadron, a division of an army consisting of 129 elephants, as many cars, 2187 horse, and 3685 foot.
E.
चम to eat or destroy, (the enemy,) and ऊ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
A soldier, a warrior.
E.
चमू, and चर who marches.

m. (-तिः)
A general of division, any general.
E.
चमू, and पति master.

m. (-रुः)
A kind of deer.
E.
चम to be eaten, ऊरच् affix, and उ final added.

r. 1st cl. (-चम्पति)
To go or move.

m. (-म्पः)
Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata.)
f. (-म्पा)
The capital of KARṆA, the modern Bhāgalpur, or a place in its vicinity.
E.
चपि to go, &c., अच् and टाप् affs.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree bearing a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.)
2 A division of the jack fruit.
n. (-कं)
The flower of the Campa.
2 A variety of the banana or plantain, (the fruit.)
E.
चपि to shine, &c. affix वुन्.

(-लुः)
The Jāka or Indian bread fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
E.
चम्पक as above, and आलुच् poss. aff.

m. (-षः)
The Jāka: see the preceding.

m. (-पः)
A name of KARṆA.
E.
चम्पा the city, and अधिप ruler.

f. (-री)
The city Campā: see चम्पा.
E.
चम्पा, and पुर a city.

m. (-लुः)
The Jāka: see चम्पकालु.
E.
चम्प for चम्पक, and आलुच् aff.

f. (-ती)
The district of Campā or Bhāgalpur.
E.
चम्प the ebony tree, and मतुप् poss. affix, abounding in such trees.

f. (-म्पूः)
A work in which the same subject is continued through alternations in the composition of prose and verse.
E.
चम to eat or be eaten, ऊ affix, and प inserted; what is relished by persons of taste.

m. (-शः)
KARṆA the natural brother of the Pāṇḍus.
E.
चम्पा the city Campā, and ईश sovereign.

m. (-तः)
The district of Campā or Bhāgalpur, or
m. plu. (-ताः)
The inhabitants.
E.
चम्प the ebony, and उपलक्षित designated: see चम्पावती.

r. 1st cl. (चम्बति)
To go, to move.

m. (-ष्पः)
1 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.)
2 A kind of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.)
3 The mango tree.
4 A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
E.
चामर a Chowri, and पुष्प a flower; whose flowers grow in clusters like the Indian Chowri.

m. (-कः)
A kind of grass: see काश.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-री)
A horse.
E.
चामर a Chowri, and इनि affix, either alluding to his bushy tail, or the custom of whisking off flies, &c. from the animal.

n. (-रं)
Gold.
E.
चमीकर, said to mean a kind of mine, and अण् affix implying production.

f. (-ण्डा)
1 A name of DURGĀ.
2 One of the Mātṛkās.
E.
च the moon, and मुण्ड the head; having a head like the moon; or चा for चण्ड the name of a demon, and मुण्ड the skull; having seized the decapitated head of the demon: in either case the deriv. is irregular: see चर्म्ममुण्डा, &c.

f. (-ला)
A river.

m. (-यः)
1 The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.)
2 A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
चम्पा the district, and ढक् aff.

n. (-म्यं)
Food, &c.
E.
चम to eat, ण्यत् aff.
